name: Input Buffer
description: Click a little early and still hit the jump: buffers your jump input for orbs and landings. Works on mobile.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the input buffer on or off.

buffer-window-ms.name: Buffer window (ms)
buffer-window-ms.description: How long (in milliseconds) an early click stays alive after you release it. Small values feel stricter, large values forgive earlier clicks but can cause jumps you did not want.

debug-log.name: Debug log
debug-log.description: Write a line to the Geode log every time a click is buffered. Useful to check that the mod is working.
